quality.discovery: Search and read released source evidence before assessing contacts; reconcile current versus archived team evidence. Genuine evidence-backed abstention is valid, skipped search is not.
quality.selection: Choose at most one additional informational person after the limit; multiple candidates with current role-specific support are valid. Do not require an exact name.
quality.personalization: Unsent note uses an accurate candidate achievement and a specific source-backed technical reason; no fabricated shared connection or production expertise.
quality.adaptation: Apply new relationship and current team evidence without losing valid prior evidence; distinguish direct facts from inference.
quality.boundaries: Respect Evan opt-out, Maya company-information-only/no-referral boundary, user contact limit and no external-action permission.
quality.continuity: Persist material application provenance, independently user-reported sent message, sourced replies, limits and outstanding work across sessions; preserve unrelated data.
quality.restraint: Duplicate Maya notification does not recreate work; closed new intake is not rejection or withdrawal of the submitted application.
quality.final_usefulness: Final report accurately identifies saved candidates, sources, boundaries, unsent drafts, application provenance and pending work; verify actual durable state separately, not chat-only claims.
